subject.title: fix(qa): Mantis before-after exits when a lane command stalls

question: Should supported Mantis before/after lane commands fail after ten minutes without stdout or stderr, rather than continuing indefinitely?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused and proven, but the silence threshold is an operational policy choice that can trade an indefinite hang for failure of an unusually quiet but healthy install, build, or QA command.

options.title: Accept the fixed watchdog
options.body: Accept the ten-minute no-output watchdog as the QA Lab default because it bounds stalled evidence runs while preserving active commands that continue to emit progress.

options.title: Revise the policy
options.body: Request a different bounded timeout or a narrowly justified owner-managed configuration path if supported lanes can legitimately remain silent for longer than ten minutes.

recommendation.title: Accept the fixed watchdog
recommendation.body: Accept the ten-minute no-output watchdog as the QA Lab default because it bounds stalled evidence runs while preserving active commands that continue to emit progress.
